theme.name: Catppuccin Frost Mocha
theme.description: Catppuccin Mocha dark palette with pronounced drifting mauve, teal and blue halos and fine grain

changelog: Stronger halo intensity in Catppuccin Frost Mocha; mauve and teal positions swapped, with mauve toward the upper left, teal toward the right and blue toward the bottom. Declarative theme.json only; frosted overlay blur requires support in the CadencR application.
